title: Oshi no Ko
source: Oshi no Ko manga by Aka Akasaka and Mengo Yokoyari (ended 2024).
world: A doctor and his young patient are reborn as Aqua and Ruby, the secret twin children of top idol Ai Hoshino of B-Komachi. When Ai is murdered, Aqua spends his life in show business hunting the man behind it, while Ruby chases her mother's dream of being an idol. The series looks behind the glamour of idols, acting, reality TV and manga adaptations. Bright on the surface, dark underneath.
power_system: No magic powers. Reincarnation is the only supernatural element; star-shaped glints in the eyes show strong emotion and talent.
